MappedPercent.note: Bowtie2's overall alignment rate against the target genome, before filtering and deduplication (MultiQC section 'Bowtie2 (target)', path filter ./bowtie2/*.bowtie2.log in assets/multiqc_config.yml). Already a percentage. Checked against the 3.1 AWS test_full run (fixture 3.1-aws-test_full). A replicate sequenced over several runs is a multi-run sample and gets no backfill.

FingerprintJSD.note: deepTools plotFingerprint's Synthetic JS Distance (--skipZeros), 0 to 1, higher meaning more enrichment, from 04_reporting/deeptools_qc/<sample>.plotFingerprint.qcmetrics.txt. cutandrun fingerprints every library, IgG controls too, one BAM per file; checked against the 3.1 AWS test_full run. Multi-run samples get no backfill.

GCPercent.note: FastQC on the raw reads (section 'FastQC (raw)'). The release's extra_fn_clean_trim drops _1 and _2, so both mates' reports fold into one row named after the replicate, and multiqc_sources.txt shows that row holds read 2's report; GC content differs little between mates. Checked against the 3.1 AWS test_full run. Multi-run samples get no backfill.

DuplicationPercent.note: Picard MarkDuplicates on each replicate's filtered target alignment (multiqc_picard_dups.txt, PERCENT_DUPLICATION, a 0-1 fraction x100 by $derived.duplication_pct). Checked against the 3.1 AWS test_full run. Multi-run samples get no backfill.

deliberately_unmapped.why: The primary caller's FRiP score, a 0-1 fraction; that caller's peak rows read it as FRiPPercent through @seacr_frip_pct or @macs2_frip_pct.
The primary caller's peak count; that caller's peak rows read it as PeakCount through @seacr_peak_count or @macs2_peak_count.

The share of bases Trim Galore trimmed, not the share of reads with adapter that AdapterPercent means.

unmapped_files.why: Reference FASTA, sizes, annotation and Bowtie2 indexes (with --save_reference): reference files, not sample data.
FastQC reports, Trim Galore logs and trimmed reads (with --save_trimmed), merged technical-replicate FASTQ (with --save_merged_fastq): QC and intermediates of the registered alignment.
Spike-in alignments (with --save_spikein_aligned) and their logs: used only to compute the normalisation factor.
Bowtie2 logs: summarised in MultiQC, where MappedPercent comes from.
Reads Bowtie2 could not align (with --save_unaligned): not a result of the analysis.
The raw, sorted and quality-filtered alignments and their indexes (with --save_align_intermed): earlier states of the deduplicated or duplicate-marked BAM the aln rule registers.
samtools QC of the intermediate and the registered alignments: summarised in MultiQC.
The linear-duplicate removal metrics (with --remove_linear_duplicates): QC, shown in MultiQC.
Picard MarkDuplicates metrics: DuplicationPercent reads the same numbers from MultiQC.
Per-replicate coverage bedGraphs: the input of SEACR and of the bigWig the bigwig rule registers.
The bedGraphs clipped to chromosome ends: the step between the bedGraph and the registered bigWig.
MACS2's peak table: the same calls as the narrowPeak or broadPeak file a peaks rule registers.
MACS2 summits (narrow mode): one point per registered peak.
The first six columns of MACS2's peaks as BED, cut for consensus and IGV: the same calls as the registered peak file.
Fragment BED and fragment-length tables: the input of the FRiP score and of MultiQC's fragment-length plot.
UpSet plots of the consensus peaks: figures.
deepTools matrices and heatmaps around genes and peaks: figures and their data, rebuilt from the registered bigWigs.
deepTools PCA, correlation and fingerprint QC: figures. FingerprintJSD is read from each qcmetrics file (sample_files) onto the D.SEQ.
Preseq library-complexity curves: a curve, not a value any attribute holds.
IGV session and copies of the registered bigWigs and peaks for it: no data of its own.
MultiQC's data tables: the harvest reads them itself (multiqc_data_dirs).
